title: ETTP Entity
description: An autonomous or human entity participating in the Entity Trust Transfer Protocol.

id.description: A globally unique, stable, non-secret entity identifier.

eid.description: Optional universal autonomous entity identifier; it must not encode secrets or unnecessary personal information.

type.description: An extensible entity type identifier; implementations must not assume the set is closed.

name.description: A human-readable name for the entity.

issuer.description: Optional identifier or label for the authority that issued the entity description.

owner.description: Optional identifier or label for the entity's owner.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the entity can attempt; listing a capability does not authorize an action.

metadata.description: Descriptive entity metadata. It does not grant authority or alter protocol semantics.

protocol_version.description: The ETTP protocol version used by this entity representation.

status.description: Lifecycle state; only ACTIVE entities may receive an ALLOW decision.

extensions.description: Optional implementation-defined extension data. Extensions must not redefine ETTP protocol fields.
